places.quote: sent me up to Highgate, on the box of the stage-coach
places.note: Then a village on the northern edge of London; the destination of David's visit to Steerforth's home.

places.quote: thinking about the Commons, and what Mr. Spenlow had said about touching the Commons
places.note: Abbreviated reference to Doctors' Commons, the ecclesiastical and admiralty courts' society; could be read as institution rather than place.
